jobs.title: Data Engineer, Machine Learning
jobs.snippet: SafetyCulture is hiring a Data Engineer for its Machine Learning team in Sydney. You will empower the Data Analytics team with the right data models, applying software engineering principles to ML pipelines. The role involves building big data datasets using Python, Scala and SQL, managing infrastructure in AWS and Databricks via Terraform, and optimising data at scale with Delta Lake, Redshift, and ML architecture.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.snippet: SafetyCulture is seeking a Data Engineer to collaborate with Finance, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders to transform billions of rows of source data into high-value datasets and products. The role involves building reusable data pipelines in Python and SQL, orchestrating workflows with Airflow, and supporting data infrastructure in AWS and Databricks. Every full-time team member gets equity — real skin in the game.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Risk
jobs.snippet: Airwallex — proudly founded in Melbourne and now serving 200,000+ businesses globally — is seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer for its Risk team. You will tackle challenging ML problems in the international payment risk domain, building and deploying fraud detection and risk management models at scale. The team revolutionises applied data science and ML to support Airwallex's rapid growth across 26 global offices.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, GTM
jobs.snippet: Airwallex is hiring a Data Scientist for its Go-to-Market team in Melbourne, requiring 3+ years of industry experience and an advanced degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or Economics). You will leverage advanced analytical techniques and machine learning to deliver data-driven insights that accelerate commercial growth across the global fintech and payments platform.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning Platform
jobs.snippet: Airwallex is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build and evolve its Machine Learning Platform into a fully AI-agent-ready infrastructure. You will design and maintain the systems powering production-grade ML models across Airwallex's global operations, enabling data scientists and ML engineers to ship models faster and more reliably at scale.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Zip Co is hiring a Senior Data Scientist in Sydney to build and deploy cutting-edge AI and ML solutions that drive business growth. You will spearhead development of innovative AI solutions leveraging LLMs and AI Agents, architect sophisticated ML models (supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning), and deliver measurable impact across the buy-now-pay-later platform serving Australia and the Americas.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: Zip Co is seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to build and operate the infrastructure powering production-grade ML across the platform. Requiring 8+ years of ML experience with a focus on distributed data systems, you will manage the full ML lifecycle from experimentation to production deployment, enabling Zip's AI-driven financial services for over 6 million customers.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Generative & Agentic AI
jobs.snippet: Zip Co is looking for a Principal Engineer to lead the transformation of their financial platform with Generative AI and Agentic systems at its core. This senior Sydney role requires deep expertise in LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and autonomous agent design, driving Zip's next generation of AI-powered payment experiences and redefining how millions of customers interact with financial services.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Ops Engineer
jobs.snippet: Eucalyptus, one of Australia's fastest-growing digital health companies, is hiring a Machine Learning Ops Engineer in Sydney. You will build and maintain the infrastructure for deploying and scaling ML models across Eucalyptus health products, including model monitoring, CI/CD pipelines for ML systems, and ensuring production reliability for AI features serving hundreds of thousands of patients.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: carsales.com.au is seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer in Melbourne to join the AI team powering Australia's number-one automotive marketplace. You will build and scale ML systems for vehicle valuation, personalised recommendations, and search ranking, contributing to carsales' strategy to become a fully AI-driven platform serving millions of car buyers and sellers every month.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Lendi Group — Australia's largest digital mortgage broker — is hiring a Senior Data Scientist in Sydney to drive advanced analytics and ML across its AI-native fintech platform. You will be part of a multi-disciplinary engineering team designing and deploying AI systems for agentic automation in property buying and mortgage broking, directly shaping the future of how Australians own and finance homes.

jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist, Machine Learning
jobs.snippet: Employment Hero, Australia's HR and payroll unicorn valued at $1.2B+, is hiring a remote Lead Data Scientist to drive ML for revenue generation. You will own end-to-end ML model development from scratch through to production, requiring prior experience as a Lead or Senior Data Scientist in a product-led tech business and deep hands-on expertise building and shipping production ML systems.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Latitude Financial Services, Australia's largest non-bank lender, is hiring a Data Scientist in Melbourne to unlock actionable insights from vast datasets. You will leverage advanced analytical techniques including machine learning, predictive modelling, and LLM integration to enhance product offerings and optimise operational efficiency across Latitude's digital payments and consumer finance platform.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: Rokt — Australia's $3.5B ecommerce technology unicorn — is hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer for its Brain Relevancy team in Surry Hills, Sydney, with total compensation of $375,000–$515,000. You will translate cutting-edge academic ML insights into scalable real-time products across 7.5 billion transactions and 400 million customers, delivering highly relevant ecommerce experiences at the moment of purchase.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.snippet: Rokt is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer for its Brain Relevancy team, targeting candidates nearing PhD completion in ML or equivalent hands-on experience. Joining the Sydney office at Surry Hills, you will work on real-time ML systems that personalise experiences for 400 million customers across 7.5 billion transactions. Total compensation: $245,000–$260,000.

jobs.title: SLAM算法工程师（2027届拓疆者校招）
jobs.snippet: 大疆创新2027届"拓疆者"校园招聘6月25日正式开启，招聘SLAM算法工程师。负责研发基于多传感器（视觉/LiDAR/GNSS）的紧耦合定位算法、建图重定位及语义SLAM，推进机器学习在无人机定位功能中的应用。深圳总部，招满即止，初筛7月至9月中旬。

jobs.title: 感知算法工程师（2027届拓疆者校招）
jobs.snippet: 大疆创新2027届拓疆者校招招聘感知算法工程师，负责无人机视觉感知系统研发，包括目标检测与跟踪、场景理解、三维重建等算法的设计与优化。深圳，候选人需具备扎实的计算机视觉与深度学习基础，参与前沿感知算法从原型到量产的全流程。2027届优秀毕业生，具备竞赛或顶会经历者优先。

jobs.title: 机器学习算法工程师（2027届拓疆者校招）
jobs.snippet: 大疆创新2027届拓疆者校招招聘机器学习算法工程师，探索大模型能力在无人机业务数据生成、自动标注中的应用可行性，以及大模型赋能无人机智能化的路径研究。深圳，岗位覆盖世界模型、生成式场景体系及4DGS等前沿方向，候选人需熟悉主流深度学习框架。

jobs.title: 世界模型算法实习生（理想星顶尖实习计划）
jobs.snippet: 理想汽车基座模型团队开放"理想星"顶尖实习计划，招聘世界模型算法实习生。工作内容包括多模态传感器时空对齐、4D时空场景重建、3DGS/Mesh处理算法研发，以及构建生成式场景体系及4D世界模型。北京/上海，市场顶薪+校招直通，面向在读本硕博毕业生。

jobs.title: 具身智能算法实习生（理想星顶尖实习计划）
jobs.snippet: 理想汽车"理想星"顶尖实习计划招聘具身智能算法实习生，基于理想汽车VLA大模型从事机器人具身智能算法研究与开发。候选人需具备深度学习与强化学习基础，有机器人操控或运动规划研究经历者优先。北京/上海，实习期表现优秀可直通校招流程。

jobs.title: VLA大模型算法实习生（理想星顶尖实习计划）
jobs.snippet: 理想汽车基座模型团队招聘VLA大模型算法实习生，参与理想汽车"司机大模型"跨本体VLA模型的研发——该模型已在Thor-U芯片完成部署并实现辅助驾驶"私人司机"能力，入选多项顶级学术会议。北京，候选人需熟悉多模态大模型架构，有LLM/VLM实习或论文经历者优先。

jobs.title: AI搜索Agent算法工程师-Seed大模型人才校招
jobs.snippet: 字节跳动Seed大模型团队2027届人才校招正式启动，招聘AI搜索Agent算法工程师。负责豆包AI搜索Agent的核心算法研发，包括query理解、检索优化、意图识别与多轮对话Agent系统设计。北京，面向2027届优秀毕业生，优异的2026届生可适当放宽，有顶会论文或大模型相关经历者优先。

jobs.title: 大模型Agent算法工程师/专家
jobs.snippet: 小红书AI平台团队招聘大模型Agent算法工程师/专家（社招/校招/实习），负责Agent核心架构建设、大模型调优与对齐、搜索/内容创作/电商等垂类智能体的落地，以及评测与迭代体系建设。上海，要求具备LLM后训练、RLHF/DPO经验，熟悉Agent框架与Tool Use机制设计，有大模型落地项目经验者优先。

jobs.title: 深度学习编译器工程师（2027届校招）
jobs.snippet: 中科寒武纪面向2027届招聘深度学习编译器工程师，负责寒武纪AI芯片的编译器优化，包括算子融合、图优化、内存规划及量化感知训练支持。上海，候选人需熟悉MLIR/TVM/XLA等主流编译器框架，有AI芯片编译器或深度学习框架开发经验者优先。寒武纪是国内领先的AI芯片与智能计算解决方案企业。

jobs.title: AI推理优化工程师（2027届校招）
jobs.snippet: 中科寒武纪招聘AI推理优化工程师，专注于大语言模型在寒武纪AI芯片平台的推理加速，涵盖量化、剪枝、蒸馏及特定硬件指令集优化。上海/北京，与主流LLM团队合作探索Llama/Qwen/GLM等模型在寒武纪平台的最优部署方案，候选人需具备深度学习理论基础和C++工程能力。

jobs.title: 大模型应用算法工程师
jobs.snippet: SHEIN招聘大模型应用算法工程师，负责大语言模型在时尚零售场景的应用落地，包括商品描述智能生成、AI搜索增强、个性化推荐及虚拟试衣等功能。广州，候选人需具备NLP或多模态大模型经验，熟悉RAG、Agent及提示词工程，有电商AI实践经验者优先，面向应届及1-2年经验候选人。

jobs.title: 多模态大模型算法工程师-Seed大模型人才校招
jobs.snippet: 字节跳动Seed大模型2027届校招招聘多模态大模型算法工程师，负责图文视频理解与生成大模型的训练与优化，包括预训练数据处理、RLHF微调、多模态对齐与模型评估。北京，Seed大模型校招面向2027届优秀毕业生，与豆包/Seedream等世界级大模型团队共同成长，优先考虑顶会论文或多模态大模型研究经历者。
